meshFormat: Native Unity .asset; no FBX/OBJ/Blender authoring files are claimed.
redistributionLicense: Not supplied by this package; asset rights remain with their respective owners.
limitations: This is a selected art-only pack, not the complete original game or a Unity project.
636 meshes were restored from exact-mapped source data; other mesh files originate from the supplied AssetRipper export.
Original materials and textures are retained from the recovery export; original rendering fidelity has not been established.
All 33 exported shaders are placeholders (DummyShaderTextExporter). They are retained to preserve material references, not to claim original rendering.
The known missing LiberationSans fallback font-atlas texture is not invented or replaced.
Only prefabs with no MonoBehaviour and no GUID dependency outside the core selection or Unity builtins are included.
No game scripts, vendor DLLs, SDK configuration, scene demo, XAPK, native game binaries, Library cache, Git commit, or push is included.
